_comment: SALES DEMO / PREVIEW. Summit Ridge Roofing is a FICTIONAL DFW roofing prospect. This config drives a preview dashboard that mirrors what a real Wing client (Hero's, Jackson) receives, so a prospect on a Zoom pitch can see the exact deliverable. There is no git repo and no live site: content comes from a hand-authored demo state file (summit-ridge-roofing.state.json) and every URL is illustrative. The brand subhead states plainly that this is a sample so no one mistakes it for delivered work.

brand.name: Summit Ridge Roofing
brand.headline: What your Summit Ridge Roofing dashboard would look like
brand.subhead: This is a SAMPLE preview built with example content to show the exact dashboard a Summit Ridge account would get. The pages, posts and figures below are illustrative demo data, not work delivered on a live site.
brand._demo_comment: These three objects (leadsFeed, activity, projection) drive the demo-only 'Leads coming in', 'Messages and reviews', and typical-client band. They live under brand ON PURPOSE so build.py passes them through unchanged (it copies the brand object whole). They exist ONLY on this SAMPLE preview, real clients have no such keys, so those sections never render for them and no lead/review numbers are ever fabricated. Every value here is illustrative sample data.

leadsFeed.note: Sample view of leads landing in your account, tagged by where each one came from. In a live account these fill in automatically as calls and form fills arrive.

activity.note: Sample view of the review and follow-up messaging that runs after each job, review asks, missed-call text-backs, and lead follow-ups, all sent for you.

projection.label: Typical results · illustrative
projection.text: Clients in your area typically see 20 to 40 new leads a month once the full system is running.
projection.sub: A typical range for roofers in comparable DFW markets, shown for illustration only. It is not a guarantee, a promise, or a forecast of specific results for Summit Ridge Roofing.

contacts.note: A sample of the enriched contact database Wing builds and maintains for your account, homeowners and referral partners across your DFW service area, each with verified contact details. In a live account this grows automatically as we find and verify new records.
contacts.caption: Sample data shown for illustration only, names and details are examples, and phone numbers use the reserved 555 range so no real person is implied. Real contacts are built and enriched for your account.

_theme_comment: Roofing-appropriate palette: deep slate-blue brand tile (#24344d) with a warm amber accent for pop. Distinct from Hero's navy/red. Dark mode uses a lifted amber so it stays legible on the dark ground; light mode drops to a deeper amber for contrast on white.
